description:
USB rechargeable mist fan with 5000mAh battery is the quick-fix cooler for hot desks, humid rooms, and power-cut evenings. This portable double‑ended mini desktop fan pushes air from two sides for wider coverage than a regular single fan, while the fine spray mist helps you feel cooler fast—without soaking your face or clothes. Keep it on your work table, bedside, study desk, or take it outdoors for balcony time, camping, or travel.

Choose Low/Medium/High speed, tilt it for targeted airflow, and control speed, mist, and light from the included remote. With up to 8 hours runtime on low and a quiet ≤45 dB sound level, it’s ideal for calls, focus sessions, or sleep. Charge it via USB Type‑C (5V/2A), refill the 100ml tank, and get that fresh, chilled breeze on demand.

features: Double‑ended airflow coverage: Two counter‑rotating fan heads spread a wider breeze, so you feel cool even if you’re not sitting perfectly in front of it.
Cooling mist that won’t drench you: Built‑in 100ml tank releases a fine spray for a fresher feel in dry heat and stuffy rooms.
5000mAh rechargeable battery: Runs up to 8 hours on Low (approx. 5h Medium / 3h High), ideal for long work sessions and power cuts.
USB Type‑C charging (5V/2A): Convenient charging from adapters, laptops, or power banks with about 4 hours charging time.
3 speed levels for comfort control: From gentle night breeze to stronger desk cooling for peak afternoon heat.
360° vertical tilt/rotation: Aim the airflow where you need it—face, neck, or across the room—without moving the base.
Remote control convenience: Adjust fan speed, mist, and light from up to 5m—perfect for bed, sofa, or meetings.
Quiet operation for focus and sleep: ≤45 dB noise level keeps the background calm for calls, study, and nighttime use.
Travel-ready build and safety: Lightweight (550g) ABS body with overheat and short-circuit protection for daily carry.
